_numbering_note: catalog_number pending the base/hybrid renumbering (was #31 in the v1 system); csv_id is authoritative.
sub_palette: akkadian backbone + latinate (classical) substrate (cross-family blend, Akkadian-leaning)

blend.backbone: akkadian (near_eastern): the alu river-cities, the sharru/shar-kishshati ladder, the bit-ili temple-towers, construct-chain toponyms, emphatic gutturals (q, kh, ', sh, ts), mimation -u/-um, theophoric god-king names
blend.overlay: latinate (classical): a Romanizing legal and administrative substrate - the dinu law-code, the via/iter roads, the colonia, the -us magistracies and the Legio, supplying the civic/legal/material register beneath the Akkadian crown
blend.lean: Akkadian-heavy - a Mesopotamian god-king order (the sharru over the alu-cities and the bit-ili) that absorbed a Romanizing legal and administrative apparatus: the throne and the temple are Akkadian, the law-court, the roads and the magistracy are the Latin substrate that runs the empire's machinery.

_note: Cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_03 Shinarur (Mesopotamian) x BASE_06 Agrippan/Latin (classical). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: Mesopotamian base = Civilized, classical base = Civilized, so Sargonid is Civilized (feudal). Concept: a supreme law-giving empire - the Mesopotamian law-code and god-king tradition fused with a Romanizing legal and administrative order. Backbone = Akkadian (near_eastern: phonology, the alu cities, the sharru ladder, the bit-ili temples); substrate = Latinate (classical: the Roman legal/administrative register, Imperator/Praefectus/Legio, the dinu law-code, the via roads, the -us offices). civ = feudal. Common-word lexicon is now a SINGLE fused tongue (Akkadian-shaped, Latin-substrated); rank titles use ENGLISH display with the real Akkadian ruler_native (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon drawn from both parents' sets (Akkadian primary, Latinate variant), never real Mesopotamian/Roman gods. CHARACTER NOTE: though all three alignments are now permitted, Sargonid remains the apex law-empire and leans strongly Lawful in flavor - the law-stele and the temple-tower are its altars, the celestial magistracy gave the law, and the Chaotic powers are the demon-marshals it exists to suppress. [REWORKED 2026-06-27 to base/hybrid model: csv_id HYB_22; all-three alignment (character still the apex law-empire); English display titles + Akkadian ruler_native; deep-fusion lexicon + fusion_rules.]

phonology.palette: Akkadian backbone (sh, ', kh, ts, q; vowels a i u; endings -u/-tu/-um; mimation; triconsonantal roots; construct chains) meeting a Latinate substrate (a Romanizing legal/administrative register; -us/-um/-or office-endings adapted onto the Akkadian frame). Theophoric on the Akkadian morphs (Tullaru-, Argantu-, Urlandu-) with Latinate canon variants.
phonology.phonotactics: CVC; mimation -um; construct chains; the Latin substrate is adapted to the Akkadian inventory - -us/-um/-or endings re-cut to -u/-um, penultimate stress, emphatics preserved.

sound_changes: Latin -us/-um/-or office/noun endings re-cut to the Akkadian frame: -us>-u, -um>-um (already legal), -or>-uru; nominative -s dropped

Latin clusters and exotic shapes flatten into the Akkadian inventory; v>w/b, hard-c/q>q (emphatic), x>ks, intervocalic doubling allowed; the glottal-stop and sh are added where the Akkadian root supplies them
Akkadian penultimate stress and CVC syllable shape imposed on every root; construct-chain compounding (X-Y = Y-of-X) governs derived terms
retain Akkadian sh, q, ', kh and mimation -u/-um; a Latin root keeps an audible -u/-um tail and one signature consonant (the v>w, the -t-, the -r-) so the substrate stays heard
fusion_rules.source_tilt: civic/legal/road/material/staple words from Latin roots (the administrative substrate built the law-court, the roads and the works: via>*wiu*, iter>*itru*, colonia>*kolunu*, argentum>*argentu*); rule/kin/temple/land words from Akkadian roots (the god-king crown and the temple-cities: sharru, bit, alu, naru, shadu); every root then filtered to one Akkadian-shaped phonology

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Akkadian rule/kin/temple/land-roots + Latin civic/legal/road/material-roots, all run through one Akkadian-shaped sound-law (penultimate stress, mimation, construct chains, emphatics retained); portmanteaus mark the blended institutions and bloodline - the empire's law-court, roads and works carry the Latin substrate adapted to the Akkadian frame.

morphology.patronymic_form: patronymic 'mar' (son of); theophoric given names on the morphed god-stems; a Latinate gens/-us form for the higher magistracy and the legions.
morphology.compounding_rule: construct chains: Bit-[god/name] (house of), Dur-[ruler] (fort of), Kar-[god] (port of); the Latin overlay yields Colonia-[name] and -us magistracies.

title_ladder.government: feudal (a law-empire: the Sharru-Imperator over the peerage and the Confucian-strict magistracy; the law-code and the legions sustain the order)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Akkadian backbone, ascending, with a Latinate administrative substrate beneath. Hazannu (mayor) barony; Massaru (warden) march, over a Latin-styled Limis (frontier); Shaknu (appointed governor) county, ruling a Praefectura; Turtanu (commander-in-chief) duchy; Rubu (prince) principality; Sharru (king) kingdom; Shar-kishshati (king of the totality), whose APPROVED display style is the Latin-substrate Imperator, over the Kishshatu. The legions (Legio) and the law-code (the dinu) are the empire's spine. Rank ruler_native titles are the real Akkadian register; the empire display 'Imperator' is an approved commonly-known foreign term (see approved_foreign_terms_used).
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler' - here the empire ruler is 'Imperator'). The *_native conlang forms (Hazannu, Sharru, Shar-kishshati, etc.) are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.
title_ladder.heir: Mar-Sharri (son of the king / crown prince)

people_name_convention.order: given (often theophoric) + patronymic (mar-X); the magistracy and legions take a Latinate gens + -us name.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the temple-and-city register is Akkadian; the imperial magistracy and the legions use Latinate -us names.
people_name_convention.theophoric: given names from the morphed deity-names + an Akkadian verb: X-iddina (X-gave), X-uballit (X-kept-alive), Warad-X (servant-of-X). e.g. Tullaru-iddina, Warad-Urlandu.

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon (Akkadian primary, from near_eastern theonym_sets; Latinate canon-form as the learned variant), never real Mesopotamian/Roman gods. Sargonid is the apex law-empire: it reveres the One (Itarnu) above His ministers and the Lawful powers as the celestial magistracy that gave the law; the Chaotic powers are the demon-marshals it exists to suppress. The law-stele and the temple-tower (ziggurat) are the altars. (Though all three alignments are now permitted in play, the culture's character remains strongly Lawful.)
religion.the_one: Itarnu (< Aeternus; Latinate variant Aeternus - the supreme Lawgiver of Heaven, source of the Mandate of order, revered above all)

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Tullaru (sun and judgment, lord of the law-stele; Lawful)
sample_deity_renames.Numeno: Numunu (the scribe-wisdom, keeper of the code; Lawful)

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Itarnu above all, Tullaru the just lord of the law-stele, Urlandu of the sworn iron-oath, Numunu keeper of the code, Argantu of the lawful city - and names the Chaotic powers the demon-marshals (-lemnu), warded and suppressed; the law-code and the temple-tower bind the order. This is the empire's apex creed.
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the deified law-givers and just magistrates of the stele, and the city-spirits of the bit-ili and the alu; the great powers invoked at the ziggurat and the Curia situationally, for the order of the city rather than the war of Heaven.
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon - the demon-marshals reframed as liberators against the law-stele - and names the Lawful powers, and Itarnu, as the tyrant-magistracy of Heaven to be defied; the heresy the empire exists to suppress.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers are the demon-marshals the empire suppresses, each with a portfolio epithet ('-lemnu' = evil): Maraxus -> Marakshu the City-Burner; Vacidus -> Bakidu-lemnu the Unmaking; Lusanto -> Lusantu the Coin-Serpent.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Bit-ili (god-house/ziggurat) of [power]: 'the Bit-ili of Tullaru'; the law-court keeps its stele in the Latin overlay as the Curia.
religion.saints_pattern: deified law-givers and just magistrates inscribed on the temple-stele; 'the Just [name]' / Latin 'Divus [name]'.

holy_symbol_motifs.Numunu: stylus on a clay tablet beneath the scales
holy_symbol_motifs.Urlandu: an iron oath-ring crossed with the legion's standard

banks_patterns.ships: river-barge and war-galley names: 'Pride of the Naru', 'Boat of Tullaru', 'the Aquila' (Latin overlay)
banks_patterns.military_units: the Legio of [number/god] / the [god] Standard: 'the Legio of Urlandu', 'the First Standard'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: buried ziggurats and dead cities: 'the Ziggurat of Dur-[name]', 'the Sunken Ekallu'
